Enabling all young people to realise their full potential through computing and AI

Why kids still need to learn to code in the age of AI

Rapid advances in generative AI are reshaping how we live and work. We argue that learning to code is essential to build the creative and critical thinking skills that young people need to thrive.

Our position paper lays out five key reasons.

Read the paperopen_in_new

Coding for kids

Educational activities to help young people learn to code and become tech creators.

Learn to code

Easy-to-follow guides to help kids learn how to build their own games, apps, AI projects, and websites with different software and hardware.

Your code in space

Join or start a Code Club

Code Club is a global movement of computing clubs where young people develop the confidence to create with digital technologies.
